import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
import json

print("Connecting to Hopsworks...")
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="drift_weekly_features",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["entity_id"],
    event_time="event_time",
    statistics_config={
        "enabled": True,
        "histograms": True,
        "correlations": False,
        "exact_uniqueness": False,
    }
)
print(f"FG id: {fg.id}")

print("Reading data...")
df = pd.read_csv("data/features.csv")
df["event_time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["event_time"])
df = df.sort_values("event_time")

# Get unique weeks
df["week"] = df["event_time"].dt.to_period("W").apply(lambda r: r.start_time)
weeks = sorted(df["week"].unique())
print(f"Number of weeks: {len(weeks)}")

# Insert week by week
for i, week_start in enumerate(weeks):
    week_df = df[df["week"] == week_start].drop(columns=["week"])
    start_date = week_df["event_time"].min().date()
    end_date = week_df["event_time"].max().date()
    print(f"Inserting week {i+1}/{len(weeks)}: {start_date} to {end_date}, rows={len(week_df)}")
    fg.insert(week_df, wait=True)

print("\nAll weeks inserted. Getting all statistics...")
all_stats = fg.get_all_statistics()
print(f"Number of statistics snapshots: {len(all_stats)}")

# Parse and display statistics per snapshot
feature_names = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5", "f6"]
weekly_stats = []

for stat in all_stats:
    stat_dict = json.loads(stat.json())
    commit_time = stat_dict.get("windowEndCommitTime", 0)
    fds = stat_dict.get("featureDescriptiveStatistics", [])
    row = {"commit_time": commit_time}
    for fd in fds:
        fname = fd.get("featureName", "")
        if fname in feature_names:
            row[f"{fname}_mean"] = fd.get("mean")
            row[f"{fname}_stddev"] = fd.get("stddev")
            row[f"{fname}_min"] = fd.get("min")
            row[f"{fname}_max"] = fd.get("max")
    weekly_stats.append(row)

weekly_stats_df = pd.DataFrame(weekly_stats).sort_values("commit_time")
print("\nWeekly statistics (means):")
mean_cols = [f"{f}_mean" for f in feature_names]
print(weekly_stats_df[["commit_time"] + mean_cols].to_string())
print("\nWeekly statistics (stddevs):")
std_cols = [f"{f}_stddev" for f in feature_names]
print(weekly_stats_df[["commit_time"] + std_cols].to_string())

import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
import json

print("Connecting to Hopsworks...")
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="drift_weekly_features",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["entity_id"],
    event_time="event_time",
)
print(f"FG id: {fg.id}")

# Get all stats metadata (lightweight)
all_stats_meta = fg.get_all_statistics()
print(f"Number of statistics snapshots: {len(all_stats_meta)}")

# Sort by computation_time
all_stats_meta.sort(key=lambda s: s.computation_time)

feature_names = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5", "f6"]
weekly_rows = []

# Fetch full stats for each snapshot using computation_time
for meta in all_stats_meta:
    comp_time = meta.computation_time
    stat = fg.get_statistics(computation_time=comp_time)
    if stat is None or stat.feature_descriptive_statistics is None:
        print(f"No data for comp_time={comp_time}")
        continue

    row = {"computation_time": comp_time, "window_end_commit_time": meta.window_end_commit_time}
    for fd in stat.feature_descriptive_statistics:
        fname = fd.feature_name
        if fname in feature_names:
            row[f"{fname}_mean"] = fd.mean
            row[f"{fname}_stddev"] = fd.stddev
            row[f"{fname}_count"] = fd.count
    weekly_rows.append(row)

df_stats = pd.DataFrame(weekly_rows)
print(f"\nWeekly stats shape: {df_stats.shape}")
print(f"\nColumns: {list(df_stats.columns)}")

# Display means for each feature per week
mean_cols = [f"{f}_mean" for f in feature_names]
print("\n=== Weekly means per feature ===")
print(df_stats[["computation_time"] + mean_cols].to_string())

# Compute differences between consecutive weeks
print("\n=== Week-over-week mean changes ===")
for feat in feature_names:
    col = f"{feat}_mean"
    diffs = df_stats[col].diff()
    print(f"{feat}: {diffs.values.tolist()}")

# Look for biggest changes
print("\n=== Max absolute week-over-week change ===")
max_changes = {}
for feat in feature_names:
    col = f"{feat}_mean"
    diffs = df_stats[col].diff().abs()
    max_change = diffs.max()
    max_week = diffs.idxmax()
    max_changes[feat] = {"max_change": max_change, "max_week_idx": max_week}
    print(f"{feat}: max_change={max_change:.4f} at week_idx={max_week}")

# Find which feature has the biggest change
drifted_feat = max(max_changes, key=lambda f: max_changes[f]["max_change"])
print(f"\nMost likely drifted feature: {drifted_feat}")
print(f"Max change: {max_changes[drifted_feat]['max_change']:.4f}")
print(f"At week index: {max_changes[drifted_feat]['max_week_idx']}")

import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
import json

print("Connecting to Hopsworks...")
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="drift_weekly_features",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["entity_id"],
    event_time="event_time",
)

print("Reading data from feature group...")
df = fg.read()
print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")

# Compute daily means for all features
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["event_time"]).dt.date
feature_names = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5", "f6"]
daily_means = df.groupby("date")[feature_names].mean()

print("\n=== Daily means for f3 (the drifted feature) ===")
print(daily_means["f3"].to_string())

print("\n=== Around the drift point (Feb-Mar 2026) ===")
onset_area = daily_means.loc[
    (daily_means.index >= pd.Timestamp("2026-02-20").date()) &
    (daily_means.index <= pd.Timestamp("2026-03-10").date())
]
print(onset_area[["f3"]].to_string())

# Find day-over-day changes for f3
f3_daily = daily_means["f3"]
f3_diff = f3_daily.diff()
print("\n=== Day-over-day changes for f3 ===")
print(f3_diff.to_string())

# Find the onset: first day where f3 changes significantly
baseline_mean = f3_daily.iloc[:30].mean()  # first 30 days baseline
baseline_std = f3_daily.iloc[:30].std()
print(f"\nBaseline mean (first 30 days): {baseline_mean:.4f}")
print(f"Baseline std: {baseline_std:.4f}")
print(f"Threshold (2 std): {baseline_mean + 2*baseline_std:.4f}")

# Find first day that exceeds threshold
threshold = baseline_mean + 2 * baseline_std
above_threshold = f3_daily[f3_daily > threshold]
print(f"\nFirst day exceeding threshold: {above_threshold.index[0]}")
print(f"Value on that day: {above_threshold.iloc[0]:.4f}")

# Find the exact onset by looking at when the big jump happens
print("\n=== All days around drift ===")
for i, (date, val) in enumerate(f3_daily.items()):
    if i > 0:
        prev_val = f3_daily.iloc[i-1]
        change = val - prev_val
        if abs(change) > 1.0:
            print(f"BIG CHANGE: {date}: {val:.4f} (prev: {prev_val:.4f}, change: {change:.4f})")
